pairings.ourName: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Vijaypur, Jammu
pairings.nmcName: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Vijaypur
pairings.evidence: Same institution: AIIMS Jammu at Vijaypur, Samba district. NMC row (collegeId 5214, email info@aiimsjammu.edu.in, Statutory Autonomous AIIMS (Vijaypur), 62 UG seats) is the only AIIMS in J&K. Our 'AIIMS Jammu (Vijaypur)' and 'AIIMS Vijaypur' are the same record under different spellings and are merged into this canonical name.

Same institution: the only medical college in Doda district (NMC collegeId 5145, est. 2020, 100 UG seats, Kashmir University, principalgmcdoda@gmail.com). Name drift only ('Govt.' vs 'Government', trailing ', Kashmir').

merges.canonical: Government Medical College and Associated Hospital, Rajouri
merges.reason: One institution (NMC 'Government Medical College, Rajouri, J&K', collegeId 5143, Kheora Mehra, Rajouri). 'and Associated Hospital' is the official suffix used by the college; the shorter spelling is the same college.

merges.canonical: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Vijaypur, Jammu
merges.reason: Three spellings of the single AIIMS in Jammu & Kashmir, located at Vijaypur (Samba district) and commonly called AIIMS Jammu. Only one AIIMS exists in the state (NMC collegeId 5214).

merges.canonical: Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences (SKIMS) Medical College, Bemina/Srinagar
merges.reason: Same institution: SKIMS Medical College & Hospital, Bemina, Srinagar (the MBBS college run under SKIMS). Both records name Bemina explicitly, so this is a spelling variant, not the separate SKIMS Soura campus.
